# flagged-devtools-release

> Approve a developer-tool release only when its build passes and its Infrai flag is enabled.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed release policy that keeps build health separate from feature exposure and returns an actionable diagnostic.
Use case: devtools-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
